# TagsInput { #anylumino.TagsInput }

```python
TagsInput(
    value=(),
    allowed_tags=None,
    allow_duplicates=False,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
    layout=None,
    style=None,
)
```

List input for string tags.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type     | Description                                              | Default    |
|------------------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `()` |
| allowed_tags | optional | Optional allowed values for tag-style inputs. | `None` |
| allow_duplicates | optional | Whether duplicate entries are allowed. | `False` |
| description | optional | Label shown next to the control. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| layout | optional | ipywidgets ``Layout`` object for CSS sizing and spacing. | `None` |
| style | optional | ipywidgets style object or style dictionary. | `None` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [tag_style](#anylumino.TagsInput.tag_style) | Use a predefined styling for the tags. |
| [value](#anylumino.TagsInput.value) | List of string tags |
